data.rationale: The proposal follows the same sequence (Allrecipes search, top recipe, Wikipedia origin, Notes entry) with the right output format, but it leaves out the servings parameter. It treats servings as a value read from the page instead of an input to set, and it never clicks "New note" or presses Enter. This makes the automation under-specified, since it can't set servings and the vague "first few ingredients" and "first or top-rated recipe" leave the recipe choice and ingredient count ambiguous.
